documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.text:
I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I explain what I am going to do before personal hygiene. I always close the curtains. I respect each person's culture and religion. I ask what the person wants to eat. I ask how the person wants to be treated. I ask whether the person prefers to be helped by a woman.

One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and immediately told the nurse on duty. She made the safeguarding report. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier.

I have moving and handling training and use a hoist. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.

We always work in pairs. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they want to eat. I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to day shifts.

documents.title: Cover letter
documents.text:
Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there. I have moving and handling training and use a hoist.

In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they want to eat. I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to day shifts.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
